notes: stage 3 sag of mg90-d on dev-v006-2A-D, capture-1 (thirteen rails 8.4 to 6.0 V, 0.2 V apart, from the DPS-150 over the feed diode, each trimmed at rest; at each a 300 ms stop lap of 1.5 V effective into the low stop, a crawl both ways, a 150 ms kick at 1.5 V effective then a hold at 0.5 V effective then a 400 ms coast, and a 30 % spin and coast both ways) and held-5 (a 12 % stall into the horn lock while the DPS stepped down, two 100 ms windows, the hold unstreamed). Current through stage 1 current-scale over each sweep's torque-off zero with the in-drive offset out, the crest sample; terminal and rail volts through stage 1 terminal-chain, the rail from the three torque-off probes per rail in the sitting manifest (TEL rows carry no vbus_raw). rail_read_minus_set_mv is the mean of the 13 per-rail differences of the graded line from the level with their range as bounds; rail_line_slope the line of the graded rail on the level, its se as bounds, rail_read_rms_mv its rms; rail_probe_spread_counts the median and range of the three probes' spread per rail; diode_drop_v the DPS setpoint less the runner's read, mean and range (dps_read is a setpoint echo); rail_minus_crest_von_mv the rail at rest less the crest tap difference under the 0.33 A stop lap, mean and range; cap_5v_pct_* the cap 100 x 5 / rail at 8.4 and 6.0 V; cap_step_pts_per_0v2 its step per 0.2 V, at 8.4 V with 8.4 V (lo) and 6.0 V (hi) as bounds. zero_asleep_counts the mean of the 39 sweeps' baseline means, the range of the baseline medians as bounds; zero_asleep_per_v_counts its line on the rail, se bounds, report only; zero_awake_step_* the last 100 ms of each of the 52 coast tails, bridge open and rotor at rest, over the same sweep's asleep zero, mean +/- sd; zero_awake_step_per_v_counts its line on the rail, se bounds. r_stop_lap_ohm is mean V_eff over mean crest current from 2 ms into each lap, mean of the 13 laps with their range as bounds, a candidate with V0 and any constant crest offset folded in, one commutator angle (the seat never moved, the pot blind on the ADC rail at the low stop); r_stop_lap_sd_pct its sd; r_stop_lap_per_v_ohm its line on the rail, se bounds; crest_over_read_per_von_locked_ma_per_v the reading term that slope implies through -R^2 G / V_eff with R the type-corrected mean, se bounds; r_stop_lap_type_reading_term_ohm the same ratio with the stage 2 type reading term (mg90-b, 4.29 mA/V) taken out of the current, comparison only, mean and range, rail dependent; lap_warming_pct the last 50 ms over the first 50 ms, mean +/- sd; lap_current_a mean and range. crawl_*: the hold's last 400 ms, speed through the nominal pot slope (19.8 counts per degree) and the counted 308.05:1 train, motor rev/s; crawl_kept_turning_n of crawl_hold_n holds had no 50 ms bin under 0.5 rev/s, one session; crawl_speed_rev_s mean and range, crawl_speed_sd_rev_s its sd; crawl_v_eff_v and crawl_current_ma mean and range; crawl_current_per_v_ma the mean of the two directions' slopes on the rail, their se in quadrature over two as bounds; crawl_current_excess_ma the crest current over (V_eff - Ke w_pot) / R with the type Ke (0.2 % from this motor's) and r_stop_lap_ohm, mean +/- sd, the hi end reaching the type-corrected R's value; crawl_ripple_over_pot_pct the ripple count over the pot, mean +/- sd; crawl_*_bin_cv_pct the sd over mean of the 50 ms bins after 200 ms, mean and range; crawl_pattern_pos_corr the pairwise r of the pot's bin speeds against position across rails, mean of the two directions with each direction as a bound; crawl_bemf_speed_*_pct the BEMF speed (V_eff - R_type I) / Ke_type on the crest current and with the type term out, over the pot. kick_breakaway_ms_fwd the first row 3 counts past the seat in direction +1, mean +/- sd (the reverse stream opens with the shaft moving, no breakaway); kick_current_at_move_a the peak of a 5-row boxcar of the current from the drive's start to that row, mean +/- sd. cycle_*: the 30 % spin's last 100 ms; cycle_speed_per_v_rev_s_fwd and _rev the ripple speed's line on the rail per direction, se bounds, from spins that had not settled; cycle_speed_settle_pct the last 100 ms over the 100 ms before, cycle_direction_split_pct +1 over -1, cycle_ripple_over_pot_pct and coast_window_under_spin_pct mean +/- sd; ke_* bemf-coast's coast route on the 26 coasts, mean +/- sd, ke_over_type_pct against mg90-b; cycle_bemf_speed_*_pct the BEMF speed with the type R and Ke over the ripple speed, on the crest current and with the type term out, mean +/- sd. held_*: held_reset false, the after window's first 5 rows within 10 mA of its mean, the sweep's rows all present and the plant stamp matched; held_i_*_a and held_v_eff_*_v the last 50 ms of the window before the first step (8.4 V) and after the hold; the DPS steps took 3.8 s against the plan's 2.0, so the after window saw 6.6 V (held_after_window_rail_v) and the last three steps ran with the drive over; held_r_app_change_pct the change of V_eff / I between the two, a candidate (warming and the crest over-read are inseparable); held_seat_shift_counts the horn lock's seat change over the hold; duty_for_1v_pct_* the duty that holds 1.0 V effective at 8.4 and 6.0 V from capture-1's rails, duty_step_for_1v_pts_per_0v2 its step per 0.2 V, smallest with the range as bounds. The DPS-150 is a stiff source trimmed at rest, so the rail axis is the state of charge and holds nothing of a pack's source impedance.
